errors.description: Collar is shown closed at the throat; the prompt asked for the top button open.
errors.correction: Open the top button so the band and the roll under the anchored points are fully exposed.

notes: SPEC LOCK honoured. Both collar points are anchored by their own button roughly 1.5 cm back from the tip, with a worked buttonhole in the point, and each point lifts into a soft rolling wave between band and tip. Point spread reads about 90 degrees as dimensioned. The band is a normal height rather than the 7.8 cm the mislabelled catalog text implies - 7.8 cm is the point length. No blue leader lines or numerals bled through from the drawing.
